pageCache.pageTitle: Vision and Values – The Brittons Academy
pageCache.text:
The Brittons Academy is at the heart of the local community providing high quality learning for all. Our vibrant, caring and innovative learning environment is underpinned by high expectations and high aspirations.
Our moral purpose is to make a difference to the life chances of every student attending the Academy. Whatever the starting point or personal circumstances, we believe that every learner can achieve success at The Brittons Academy. Our aim is to fully prepare each student for their adult life by equipping them with the skills, attributes, values and qualifications necessary to be highly successful adults.
To achieve this goal the Academy will ensure that all students:-
Achieve excellent qualifications: Qualifications are a student’s passport to success. The better their qualifications, the more doors of opportunity will be open to them. Hence, we will support all students to achieve excellent qualifications.
Unlock their potential: Every student has the potential to achieve success at school. The Academy will build aspirations and provide the opportunities to unlock the potential that resides in all students so that they have the chance to excel and experience success.
Become valued citizens: Through the development of the Academy’s core values of respect and responsibility, our students will always be respectful of others and be fully aware of their responsibilities in a global society so that they become valued members of their community. Develop healthy lifestyles: We will ensure that all students learn how to lead a healthy life style so that they make informed choices to secure their long-term health and wellbeing.
Develop the skills and attributes for lifelong success: For our students to lead successful adult lives, they must be equipped with the skills and attributes that will not only ensure that they can adapt to the rapidly changing world of work but also have the mind set and drive to succeed in their adult life no matter what they choose as a career. To this end, the Academy will ensure that we build our students’ learning power and instil a positive ‘can do’ mind set to secure their success as adults

The curriculum at The Brittons Academy can be defined as the sum of all the experiences enjoyed by each student.
Our Vision
Whatever the academic starting point, prior experience of education or personal circumstances, we believe that every learner can achieve success at The Brittons Academy.
Our over-arching moral purpose is to transform the life-chances of our students by ensuring they benefit from an ambitious curriculum, in line with National Curriculum requirements, which supports them to make progress in line with, above or significantly above national expectations.
Our aim is to fully prepare each student to participate fully in society by equipping them with the skills, attributes, values and qualifications characteristic of highly successful adults.
In short, we will ensure every learner at Brittons will benefit from quality first teaching every lesson, every day.
